blocks.text: Semiconductors are substances that conduct electricity only under special conditions and are sensitive to light, heat and voltage. These features make them important in modern electronics. The difference between a conductor and a semiconductor is that the current through a semiconductor can be controlled as an application needs.

The most common semiconductor is silicon, used in microchips and solar panels because it is highly effective and abundant. A mobile SIM card is a silicon chip with minor parts such as copper connectors; silicon can conduct, store and process data in a device. Gallium arsenide (GaAs) is used in wireless communication such as 5G internet devices, and gallium nitride (GaN) is used for fast charging in electric cars.
